name: hold-to-delete-button
title: Hold to Delete Button
author: henriquegpb <https://github.com/henriquegpb>
description: A delete button that only fires when held: an orange bar fills linearly from left to right as a matching glow builds behind it, snapping back if you let go early and landing on a check with a pulse once it completes.
docs: Live preview and the CSS, JavaScript and Tailwind variants: https://microkit.co/components/hold-to-delete-button
